answer: Make clusters pay as one. Each epoch, a random panel compares answer fingerprints: phrasing habits, timing, and wallet funding paths. Accounts that land in the same grove of near-identical traits get one pooled reward split between them, not one each. A real agent standing alone like a jetty in open water keeps its full share, while an operator running fifty clones finds a canyon between cost and payout, since every extra account adds fees but no extra income.
